pairs.target: liǎng rìhòu , lún dào dìèrshísì cì gùdìng liànxí , tǎ wéi jìnmén shí méi kànjiàn tiě , ǎi jiàshàng lì zhe liǎngzhī kōng mù tuō , zuǒbiān hòutou jì yìtiáo hóngbù , yòubiān què shénme yě méi guà .
pairs.english: Two days later came the twenty-fourth fixed practice; when Tavi entered he saw no iron; on the low rack stood two empty carriers, with a red strip tied behind the left one, while nothing hung on the right.
pairs.hanzi: 两日后，轮到第二十四次固定练习，塔维进门时没看见铁，矮架上立着两只空木托，左边后头系一条红布，右边却什么也没挂。

pairs.target: tā zuórì wèn guò lín kē néng bunéng lái bàn táng , tā shuō néng lái , què yě yào zìjǐ shì shǒu yìhuí , bù dāying měi huí dōu zhàn zài duìmiàn gěi tā dì mùtiáo .
pairs.english: Yesterday he had asked whether Lin Ke could come for half a session; she said she could, but wanted to try defending once herself too, refusing to stand opposite handing him a stick every time.
pairs.hanzi: 他昨日问过林珂能不能来半堂，她说能来，却也要自己试守一回，不答应每回都站在对面给他递木条。

pairs.target: lín kē zhàn zài jiàzi lìngyímiàn , shǒulǐ yìgēn duǎn mùtiáo , tóushàng chán zhe bù , tā xiān bǎ mùtiáo fàngdào zhuōbiān , wèn sòng yuǎn jīnrì shìbushì hái děi děng tā xiě wán zì .
pairs.english: Lin Ke stood on the other side of the rack with a short stick in hand, its tip wrapped in cloth; she first set the stick by the table and asked Song Yuan whether today they still had to wait for him to finish writing.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂站在架子另一面，手里一根短木条，头上缠着布，她先把木条放到桌边，问宋远今日是不是还得等他写完字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zì jīnrì kěyǐ wǎndiǎn xiě , huà yì chūkǒu , zìjǐ xiān jiāng cèzi gē yuǎn , lín kē kànjiàn biàn xiào , ná jiǎojiān bǎ dèngzi tuī dào tā nà yícè .
pairs.english: Tavi said the writing could be done later today; as the words came out, he first put his notebook away; Lin Ke saw and laughed, pushing the stool to his side with her toe.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说字今日可以晚点写，话一出口，自己先将册子搁远，林珂看见便笑，拿脚尖把凳子推到他那一侧。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méiyǒu ràng liǎng rén lìkè kāishǐ , jiāng jià jiǎo zhúgè àn wěn , wèn tǎ wéi zuò zhèlǐ , zuǒ xī néng bunéng liúchū kòng chù , zài bǎ bù diàn tuō dào mù tuō xiàmiàn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not have both start immediately; he steadied each rack leg, asking whether Tavi could leave room for his left knee seated here, then dragged the padding beneath the carriers.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没有让两人立刻开始，将架脚逐个按稳，问塔维坐这里，左膝能不能留出空处，再把布垫拖到木托下面。

pairs.target: jīnrì zhǐyòng kōng mù tuō , duǎnshéng réng sōng zhe , lín kē ruò yào pèng hóngbù , xiān yòng mùtiáo diǎnmíng láilù , děng tǎ wéi shuō kěyǐ , zài mànmàn shēnguòqù , bù cháo rén shēnshàng qù .
pairs.english: Today they used only empty carriers, the short cords still slack; if Lin Ke aimed to touch the red strip, first she must indicate the approach with her stick, wait for Tavi's agreement, then extend it slowly, never toward a person.
pairs.hanzi: 今日只用空木托，短绳仍松着，林珂若要碰红布，先用木条点明来路，等塔维说可以，再慢慢伸过去，不朝人身上去。

pairs.target: hóngbù búsuàn yào qiǎngzǒu de dōngxī , mùtiáo pèngdào jiù tíng , tǎ wéi yě bùnéng ná mù tuō qù jiāzhù mùtiáo , sòng yuǎn shuōwán , jiào lín kē xiān gěi tā kàn yìhuí .
pairs.english: The red strip was not something to snatch away; the stick would stop at a touch, and Tavi must not clamp it with a carrier either; after saying this Song Yuan had Lin Ke first show him once.
pairs.hanzi: 红布不算要抢走的东西，木条碰到就停，塔维也不能拿木托去夹住木条，宋远说完，叫林珂先给他看一回。

pairs.target: tā cóng zuǒcè lái , tǎ wéi zuǒshǒu xiān fúzhù mù tuō , méi děng lìngyìzhī shǒu zhǎo hǎo biàn xiǎng wǎng wài yíng , mù biān pèngdào jià yán , zhěngzhī tuō fǎndào wāi le yìdiǎn .
pairs.english: She approached from the left; Tavi steadied the carrier with his left hand first, wanting to meet her outward before his other hand was ready; the wooden edge hit the rack edge and the whole carrier tilted a little instead.
pairs.hanzi: 她从左侧来，塔维左手先扶住木托，没等另一只手找好便想往外迎，木边碰到架沿，整只托反倒歪了一点。

pairs.target: lín kē tíngxià , méiyǒu shùnshì qù qiāo nàtiáo bù , tǎ wéi bǎ mù tuō bǎihuíqù , liǎnshàng yǒuxiē rè , shuō zìjǐ méi dǎsuàn ná tā zá rén .
pairs.english: Lin Ke stopped, without exploiting the opening to tap that strip; Tavi set back the carrier, his face a little hot, saying he had not meant to hit anyone with it.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂停下，没有顺势去敲那条布，塔维把木托摆回去，脸上有些热，说自己没打算拿它砸人。

pairs.target: " kě jiàzi yě méi dǎsuàn tì nǐ nuó . "
pairs.english: “But the rack did not mean to move for you either.”
pairs.hanzi: “可架子也没打算替你挪。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán wàng xiàng sòng yuǎn , wèn shìbushì néng huàn gè wèizhì , sòng yuǎn shuō xiān ràng tǎ wéi zìjǐ kàn , tā biàn bǎ dèngzi wǎnghòu nuó le yìdiǎn , méi zài jiāng zuǒ zhǒu tiēzhe shēn cè .
pairs.english: After saying that she looked at Song Yuan, asking if they could change the position; Song Yuan said first let Tavi look for himself; he then moved the stool back a little, no longer keeping his left elbow against his side.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完望向宋远，问是不是能换个位置，宋远说先让塔维自己看，他便把凳子往后挪了一点，没再将左肘贴着身侧。

pairs.target: dìèrhuí réng cóng zuǒcè lái , tǎ wéi zhècì méi bǎ mù tuō tái chū jiàzi , zhǐ zhuǎn le yìdiǎn jiǎo , mùtiáo cā zhe bù diàn tíngzhù , méiyǒu pèngdào hóngbù .
pairs.english: The second approach was still from the left; this time Tavi did not lift the carrier off the rack, only turned it a little; the stick stopped brushing the padding, without touching the red strip.
pairs.hanzi: 第二回仍从左侧来，塔维这次没把木托抬出架子，只转了一点角，木条擦着布垫停住，没有碰到红布。

pairs.target: tā gāng xiǎng wèn shìbushì dǎng dào le , lín kē què xiān wèn xiàhuí néng bunéng zǒu biéchù , sòng yuǎn shuō kěyǐ , xiān jiào tǎ wéi xuǎn , jīnrì háiyào buyào kàn zhè yìtiáo lù .
pairs.english: He was about to ask whether he had blocked it, but Lin Ke first asked could she approach elsewhere next time; Song Yuan agreed, first having Tavi choose whether he still wanted to watch this route today.
pairs.hanzi: 他刚想问是不是挡到了，林珂却先问下回能不能走别处，宋远说可以，先叫塔维选，今日还要不要看这一条路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe yòubiān nà zhī kōng tuō , shuō yě xiǎng shì yòubiān , sòng yuǎn méiyǒu jiāng huà tīng chéng liǎngbiān kěyǐ suíbiàn lái , wèn tā shì xiān shuō qīngchǔ , háishì lián shuō yě bù shuō .
pairs.english: Tavi looked at that empty carrier on the right, saying he wanted to try the right too; Song Yuan did not interpret this as either side being free to come at will, asking him: announce it first, or not say anything at all?
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着右边那只空托，说也想试右边，宋远没有将话听成两边可以随便来，问他是先说清楚，还是连说也不说。

pairs.target: tā xiǎngqǐ qiánrì lièkāi de lúguǎn , yòu xiǎngqǐ sòng yuǎn bèi dài piān de nàgēn zhàng , shuō xiān shuō , lín kē biàn bǎ mùtiáo shōuhuí , chóngxīn zhǐxiàng yòubiān .
pairs.english: He remembered the reed cracked two days earlier, and remembered Song Yuan's deflected staff, saying announce it first; Lin Ke then withdrew the stick and pointed again toward the right.
pairs.hanzi: 他想起前日裂开的芦管，又想起宋远被带偏的那根杖，说先说，林珂便把木条收回，重新指向右边。

pairs.target: zhè yìhuí hóngbù nuó dào yòubiān , sòng yuǎn jì hǎo yǐhòu , ràng liǎng rén dōu kànguò wèizhì , lín kē réng xiān gěi tā kàn màn lù , méi ná shuō guò yòubiān biàn tūrán kuài lái shì tā .
pairs.english: This time the red strip moved to the right; after Song Yuan tied it, both were shown its position; Lin Ke still first showed him the slow approach, without using the announced side as an excuse to suddenly test him fast.
pairs.hanzi: 这一回红布挪到右边，宋远系好以后，让两人都看过位置，林珂仍先给他看慢路，没拿说过右边便突然快来试他。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yòushǒu zhuǎn de shùn , zuǒshǒu què gēnzhe lí le yuánlái nà chù , zuǒshǒu yǐjīng kōng dào shēn cè , tā cái fājué gāi huí de nàtiáo lù yòu méi liú , zìjǐ xiān jiàotíng .
pairs.english: Tavi's right hand turned smoothly, but his left followed away from its old place; only once the left hand was empty beside him did he notice he had again left no return route, and called stop himself first.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维右手转得顺，左手却跟着离了原来那处，左手已经空到身侧，他才发觉该回的那条路又没留，自己先叫停。

pairs.target: lín kē de mùtiáo cái zǒu dào yíbàn , tā tíng zài nàlǐ děng , wèn tā shì yào bǎ liǎngbiān dōu shǒuzhù me , tǎ wéi shuō búshì , zìjǐ gāngcái què zhǐ kànjiàn yòubiān dòng le .
pairs.english: Lin Ke's stick was only halfway; she stopped there to wait, asking whether he meant to defend both sides; Tavi said no, but he had just seen only the right move.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂的木条才走到一半，她停在那里等，问他是要把两边都守住么，塔维说不是，自己刚才却只看见右边动了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiào tā xiān bǎ mù tuō fàngwěn , shǒu dōu sōng xiàlái , lín kē yě jiāng mùtiáo gē huí zhuōshàng , sāngè rén xiē le yízhèn , méiyǒu bǎ tíngxià suàn chéng yòu qiàn yìhuí .
pairs.english: Song Yuan had him first set firmly down the carriers and relax both hands; Lin Ke put the stick back on the table too; all three rested a while, without counting a stop as owing another attempt.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远叫他先把木托放稳，手都松下来，林珂也将木条搁回桌上，三个人歇了一阵，没有把停下算成又欠一回。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn tā píngcháng liàn de shíhòu yě zhèyàng me , tā shuō píngcháng néng zǒukāi , kě zǒukāi yě huì cǎi dào biérén de jiǎo , zìjǐ shàng huí biàn bèi dìdi mà le bànlù .
pairs.english: Tavi asked whether her normal practice was like this too; she said normally she could step away, but stepping away could tread on someone else's foot, and her younger brother had scolded her halfway home last time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问她平常练的时候也这样么，她说平常能走开，可走开也会踩到别人的脚，自己上回便被弟弟骂了半路。

pairs.target: tā xiào chūlái , wèn duō dà de dìdi , tā shuō gòu dà le , zìjǐ méi cǎi téng tā , tā yě zhào mà , sòng yuǎn zài pángbiān shuō nà jù méi cǎi téng tīng zhe bú xiàng wèn guò .
pairs.english: He laughed and asked how old the brother was; she said old enough, she had not hurt him by treading, yet he scolded all the same; Song Yuan remarked nearby that “not hurt” did not sound as though she had asked.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑出来，问多大的弟弟，她说够大了，自己没踩疼他，他也照骂，宋远在旁边说那句没踩疼听着不像问过。

pairs.target: lín kē ná mùtiáo cháo tā diǎn yíxià , méiyǒu zhēn qiāo , suíhòu wèn xiàhuí néng bunéng ràng zìjǐ shǒu , tǎ wéi shuō néng , shǒu què xiān wǎng zuǒ xī páng fàngwěn , méi jí zhe zhàn qǐlái huàn .
pairs.english: Lin Ke pointed the stick toward him once without actually tapping him, then asked whether she could be allowed to defend next time; Tavi agreed, but first settled his hands beside his left knee, without hastily standing to swap.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂拿木条朝他点一下，没有真敲，随后问下回能不能让自己守，塔维说能，手却先往左膝旁放稳，没急着站起来换。

pairs.target: jīnrì zuìhòu yìhuí , tāmen réng yòng yòubiān , tǎ wéi xiān ràng zuǒshǒu liúzài néng kànjiàn de dìfāng , zài zhàoshuō hǎo de màn lù zhuǎn mù tuō , lín kē de mùtiáo pèngdào le hóngbù biān .
pairs.english: On today's final attempt they still used the right; Tavi first kept his left hand in a place clearly visible, then turned the carrier along the agreed slow approach; Lin Ke's stick touched the edge of the red strip.
pairs.hanzi: 今日最后一回，他们仍用右边，塔维先让左手留在能看见的地方，再照说好的慢路转木托，林珂的木条碰到了红布边。

pairs.target: tā méi néng gǎnshàng , mùtiáo què yě méiyǒu bèi tā jiāzhù , liǎng rén gè fàng huí dōngxī , lín kē jiāng nàtiáo hóngbù jiě xiàlái , shuō xiàhuí xiān gěi tā , bié yòu zìjǐ yì rén zuòmǎn .
pairs.english: He had not caught up, yet neither had he trapped the stick; both put their things back; Lin Ke untied that red strip and said next time let her go first, instead of filling the whole session himself again.
pairs.hanzi: 他没能赶上，木条却也没有被他夹住，两人各放回东西，林珂将那条红布解下来，说下回先给她，别又自己一人坐满。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ná huí cèzi , sòng yuǎn yǐjīng bǎ hóngbù fàngzài liǎngzhī kōng tuō zhōngjiān , shuí yě méiyǒu tì tā huànchéng yípiàn tiě , tā xiě dào mùtiáo pèngdào le , táitóu wèn lín kē gāngcái pèng de shì nǎ yìbiān jiǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi took back his notebook; Song Yuan had already placed the red strip between the two empty carriers, nobody replacing it with an iron piece; he wrote stick touched, then looked up to ask Lin Ke exactly which corner it had touched.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维拿回册子，宋远已经把红布放在两只空托中间，谁也没有替它换成一片铁，他写到木条碰到了，抬头问林珂刚才碰的是哪一边角。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yǐjīng zǒu dào ménkǒu , tīngjiàn zhè jù yòu zhéhuílái , qǔ mùtiáo zhǐ gěi tā kàn , línzǒu cái xiǎngqǐ hùjù , zìjǐ shēnshǒu cóng ménpáng līn le qǐlái .
pairs.english: She had already reached the door, but hearing this came back, taking the stick to show him; only when leaving did she remember her gear, reaching herself to lift it from beside the door.
pairs.hanzi: 她本来已经走到门口，听见这句又折回来，取木条指给他看，临走才想起护具，自己伸手从门旁拎了起来。
